crossRefs.note: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

translations.web: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.
translations.bsb: Through patience a ruler can be persuaded, and a gentle tongue can break a bone.
translations.kjv: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
translations.asv: By long forbearing is a ruler persuaded, And a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
